# @winterhuan/dsh-shadow-mind
English | 中文
## Summary
Review a task independently while the main agent works and before its turn ends. Define each review
responsibility in Markdown; actionable findings return to the main agent with evidence references an
d a child-session address. Use `/shadow` to inspect, pause, resume, or request a review. This bundle
targets DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` and adds model cost and completion latency.
## Use this package
Use Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24`, pnpm `11.7.0`, and exactly DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`. The profile must supply
native Agent Presets, the `spawn` provider, filesystem services, and a configured model. The standa
rd Web profile provides the required services; a custom headless profile must compose them explicitl
Web profile provides the required services; a custom headless profile must compose them explicitly.
### Install the remote release
If this profile has the unscoped `dsh-shadow-mind` package, remove that layer with `dsh plugin --pro
file web remove dsh-shadow-mind` before installing the scoped release.
Install the fixed Git revision into your existing Web profile, then restart DSH. The bundle activate
s its scheduler, commands, and review preset; add responsibility files separately. Without enabled d
efinitions, it does not start model reviews.

The bundle activates the scheduler, `/shadow` command, and review preset together. No definitions ar

y architecture.md to the same directory to opt into probabilistic background checks.
Before opening Web, select an appropriate model and workspace in the development profile. The follow
ing patch keeps default workspace files inside the temporary home.

Open the local URL printed by DSH and send a task. Rebuild, restart the development process, and har
d-refresh Web after source edits. Remove this layer with `dsh plugin --profile shadow-dev remove @wi
nterhuan/dsh-shadow-mind`.
### Control reviews
Commands act on the current root session. The command result shows recent outcomes and child-session
addresses; Web's native subagent menu opens the review transcript.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`check` waits for all enabled definitions or the selected id. It requires a previous human task and
refuses a concurrent batch or a paused session. Manual checks ignore trigger probability and count a
s the final check for that task. `pause` cancels active reviews and waits for child cleanup; `resume
` enables future triggers without replaying old work. Pause state, claimed checks, and recent outcom
es survive session restoration.

so edits apply to later activations. Start with the shipped examples; their YAML frontmatter accepts

### Bound cost and diagnose failures
Override the `shadow-mind-runtime` row in a profile patch to change these settings; config.ts owns v
alidation and allowed ranges.
| Setting | Default | Effect |

| `definitionsDirectory` | `$DSH_HOME/shadow-minds` | Responsibility files. |
| `maxParallel` | `2`

| Concurrent reviews across this plugin instance. |
| `timeoutSeconds` | `120` | Per-review deadline

including slot waiting and child startup. |
| `maxHeartbeatRunsPerTask` | `4` | Attempt budget per

human task; skipped or failed attempts consume it. |
[该节后续省略]
#### What the model sees
The main model receives no new tools or persistent prompt prefix. It receives actionable findings as
`shadow-report` relay messages with reviewer identity, child-session address, and event references.
Each fresh child receives its responsibility, quoted observations, project instructions, and only `
read`, `grep`, `glob`, and `structured_output`. Human command results and scheduler metadata stay ou
tside model context.
## Known Limitations and Deferred Work
- Final checks delay turn completion, but streamed answer text can appear before review finishes. Fi

ndings invite a correction; they do not hide or replace the first answer.
- Read-only tool exposure
is not an operating-system sandbox. The configured filesystem provider controls readable paths, and

custom implementations under allowed tool names remain trusted.
- Background evidence is a snapshot
of a live workspace. Citations and byte budgets do not prove semantic correctness, snapshot isolatio

n, or complete coverage.
- The plugin requires the native local `spawn` provider and preset composit
ion. It has no custom panel, definition-management tools, or automatic replay of interrupted reviews

. Session-format migrations may omit plugin metadata.
- Real-model review quality, Linux/Windows acc
eptance, and custom headless composition have not been validated.
